spec_match.rationale: Exercises the update-capture-state algorithm's mandatory first step (not fully active → promise rejected with InvalidStateError) via a genuinely detached iframe document, and displays the spec-required outcome beside the observed one.

interactive.rationale: One button runs the four-step detach sequence for real, ticking each step and rebuilding the observed-outcome pane and verdict from the live result.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index promises the removed-iframe call with both contracts labelled; the page delivers exactly that comparison.

edge_cases.rationale: This page is the failure-mode concept; it additionally classifies sync-throw, wrong-name rejection, and unexpected resolution outcomes, and notes the two non-deterministic MAY branches (hidden-document InvalidStateError, pause-policy NotAllowedError) as out of scope in the banner.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5188639100370944 and the spec anchor.

conformance.rationale: The suite's not-fully-active-rejects-invalidstateerror assertion runs this exact sequence client-side; on 153 it fails honestly because no promise exists, matching the page's legacy verdict.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 153 CDP driver: all four steps ticked (capture succeeded), the orphaned call returned undefined synchronously, the legacy verdict rendered, repeat run stable, zero console/page errors, zero failed requests, 0px overflow both classes, screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the observed outcome is inside the 93-or-158 contract (sync undefined or InvalidStateError rejection) and the capture-failure fallback separately.

design_system.rationale: Spec-vs-observed panes and verdict use token colours on paper/stone at AA; the helper iframe is offscreen and aria-hidden, never a blank visual element.

accessibility.rationale: Ordered-list steps with text completion marks, aria-live verdict and observed pane, native button, the throwaway iframe is aria-hidden with tabindex=-1.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: The comparison panes collapse to one column via auto-fit minmax; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×800.

openQuestions.title: Observe the real InvalidStateError rejection on Chrome 158+
openQuestions.detail: On Chromium 153 the orphaned-session call returns undefined synchronously, so only the legacy pane could be verified live. On a 158+ build the same sequence must produce the rejected promise with name InvalidStateError and flip the page to its spec-honoured verdict — confirm and capture that evidence when available.

guidanceConsulted.query: side-by-side comparison panes that stack on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, basis), 1fr)) so comparison panes sit side-by-side where space allows and stack at narrow widths without media queries.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The spec-vs-observed .compare grid uses exactly that pattern with an 18rem basis; verified stacked at 360px and side-by-side at 1280px with 0px overflow.

guidanceConsulted.query: progress steps and async outcome announcements
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Represent sequence progress as real list semantics with text markers, and announce the final outcome in a polite region rather than per-step churn.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Steps are an ol with appended text 'done' marks; the observed pane and verdict are the polite regions announcing the outcome once per run.

summary: The spec's one mandatory rejection, run for real: capture a removed iframe's mediaSession, call setMicrophoneActive(true), and compare the spec-required InvalidStateError rejection with what the build actually did. Verified with the headless Chromium 153 CDP driver: capture succeeded, the orphaned call returned undefined synchronously (legacy verdict, honestly labelled), repeat run stable, clean console/network, ok/ok responsive matrix.
